label: ck-kpis/outcomes
sql:
SELECT
  countIf(at >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}) AS closed,
  countIf(at >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND outcome = 'resolved') AS resolved,
  countIf(at < {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}) AS closed_prev,
  countIf(at < {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND outcome = 'resolved') AS resolved_prev
FROM (SELECT trace_id,
    any(at) AS at, argMax(outcome, sent) AS outcome, argMax(reason, sent) AS reason
  FROM (
    SELECT trace_id, at, label AS outcome, label AS reason, 0 AS sent
    FROM (SELECT
    e.TraceId AS trace_id, t.OccurredAt AS at, e.EvaluatorName AS evaluator, e.Label AS label,
    e.Passed = 1 AS ok, e.Passed IS NOT NULL AND NOT e.IsGuardrail
      AND e.EvaluatorName != 'Conversation Outcome Judge' AS is_check,
    t.customer AS customer
  FROM evaluation_metrics AS e
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT TraceId, OccurredAt, ifNull(CustomerId, '') AS customer
    FROM trace_metrics
    WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})) AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
  ) AS t ON t.TraceId = e.TraceId
  WHERE e.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( e.OccurredAt >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}))))
    WHERE evaluator = 'Conversation Outcome Judge'
      AND label != ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT TraceId AS trace_id, OccurredAt AS at, Attributes['metadata.outcome'] AS outcome,
      coalesce(nullIf(Attributes['metadata.outcome_reason'], ''), Attributes['metadata.outcome']) AS reason,
      1 AS sent
    FROM traces
    WHERE (traces.TenantId, traces.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})) AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
      AND Attributes['metadata.outcome'] != '')
  )
  GROUP BY trace_id)

SELECT trace_id, operation, has_error, latency_ms, cost, feedback, p95_latency,
  round(40 * has_error

    + 20 * least(ifNull(cost / nullIf(p95_cost, 0), 0), 2) / 2
    + 15 * (feedback = 'down')) AS impact
FROM (
  SELECT t.TraceId AS trace_id,
    t.TraceName AS operation,
    if(t.HasError, 1, 0) AS has_error,
    t.TotalDurationMs AS latency_ms,
    t.TotalCost AS cost,
    multiIf(a.thumbs_down > 0, 'down', a.thumbs_up > 0, 'up', '') AS feedback,

    quantileExact(0.95)(t.TotalCost) OVER () AS p95_cost
  FROM trace_metrics AS t
  LEFT JOIN (

  WHERE t.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( t.OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND t.OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
)

  (SELECT toDateTime(max(first_seen)) FROM (SELECT Model, min(BucketStart) AS first_seen
  FROM model_usage_by_minute
  WHERE BucketStart >= subtractDays({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, 30)
    AND BucketStart < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
    AND Model != ''
  GROUP BY Model
  HAVING first_seen >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}
    AND first_seen >= addDays((SELECT min(BucketStart) FROM model_usage_by_minute
      WHERE BucketStart >= subtractDays({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, 30)
    AND BucketStart < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
    AND Model != ''), 1)))) AS changed_at,
  least(addDays(changed_at, 7), {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}) AS after_end,
  subtractDays(changed_at, 7) AS before_start,
  subtractDays(after_end, 7) AS before_end
SELECT OccurredAt >= changed_at AND OccurredAt < after_end AS after,
  count() AS traces,
  countIf(HasError) / count() AS error_rate,
  quantileExact(0.95)(TotalDurationMs) AS p95_ms,
  sum(TotalCost) / count() AS cost_per_trace
FROM trace_metrics
WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( changed_at > toDateTime(0)
  AND (OccurredAt >= changed_at AND OccurredAt < after_end OR OccurredAt >= before_start AND OccurredAt < before_end))

  (SELECT toDateTime(max(first_seen)) FROM (SELECT Model, min(BucketStart) AS first_seen
  FROM model_usage_by_minute
  WHERE BucketStart >= subtractDays({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, 30)
    AND BucketStart < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
    AND Model != ''
  GROUP BY Model
  HAVING first_seen >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}
    AND first_seen >= addDays((SELECT min(BucketStart) FROM model_usage_by_minute
      WHERE BucketStart >= subtractDays({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, 30)
    AND BucketStart < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
    AND Model != ''), 1)))) AS changed_at,
  least(addDays(changed_at, 7), {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}) AS after_end,
  subtractDays(changed_at, 7) AS before_start,
  subtractDays(after_end, 7) AS before_end
SELECT sum(before_passed) / nullIf(sum(before_judged), 0) AS before_rate,
  sum(after_passed) / nullIf(sum(after_judged), 0) AS after_rate,
  sumIf(before_judged * after_passed / after_judged, after_judged > 0)
    / nullIf(sumIf(before_judged, after_judged > 0), 0) AS after_even_rate,
  sum(before_judged) AS before_checks,
  sum(after_judged) AS after_checks
FROM (
  SELECT ifNull(t.TopicId, '') AS topic,
    countIf(t.OccurredAt >= before_start AND t.OccurredAt < before_end AND e.Passed = 1) AS before_passed,
    countIf(t.OccurredAt >= before_start AND t.OccurredAt < before_end) AS before_judged,
    countIf(t.OccurredAt >= changed_at AND t.OccurredAt < after_end AND e.Passed = 1) AS after_passed,
    countIf(t.OccurredAt >= changed_at AND t.OccurredAt < after_end) AS after_judged
  FROM evaluation_metrics AS e
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT TraceId, TopicId, OccurredAt
    FROM trace_metrics
    WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= changed_at AND OccurredAt < after_end OR OccurredAt >= before_start AND OccurredAt < before_end)
  ) AS t ON t.TraceId = e.TraceId
  WHERE e.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( changed_at > toDateTime(0)
    AND e.Passed IS NOT NULL
    AND e.OccurredAt >= before_start)
  GROUP BY topic
)

SELECT
  sum(cost) AS spend,
  countIf(failed) AS failed_traces,
  sumIf(cost, failed) AS failed_cost,
  countIf(NOT failed AND repeats > 0) AS loop_traces,
  sumIf(cost * repeats / greatest(spans, 1), NOT failed AND repeats > 0) AS loop_cost,
  countIf(NOT failed AND repeats = 0 AND retries > 0) AS retry_traces,
  sumIf(retries * llm_cost / greatest(llm_ok, 1), NOT failed AND repeats = 0 AND retries > 0)
    AS retry_cost
FROM (SELECT ifNull(s.failed, 0) = 1 AS failed, t.cost AS cost,
    ifNull(s.spans, 0) AS spans, ifNull(s.retries, 0) AS retries,
    ifNull(s.repeats, 0) AS repeats, ifNull(s.llm_cost, 0) AS llm_cost, ifNull(s.llm_ok, 0) AS llm_ok
  FROM (
    SELECT TraceId, TotalCost AS cost
    FROM trace_metrics
    WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
  ) AS t
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT TraceId, max(root_failed) AS failed, sum(calls) AS spans, sum(errored_llm) AS retries,
      sumIf(calls - 1, is_tool AND calls >= 3) AS repeats,
      sum(ok_llm_cost) AS llm_cost, sum(ok_llm) AS llm_ok
    FROM (
      SELECT TraceId, SpanName,
        SpanAttributes['langwatch.span.type'] = 'tool' AS is_tool,
        count() AS calls,
        max(ifNull(ParentSpanId, '') = '' AND StatusCode = 2) AS root_failed,
        countIf(StatusCode = 2 AND SpanAttributes['langwatch.span.type'] = 'llm') AS errored_llm,
        countIf(StatusCode != 2 AND SpanAttributes['langwatch.span.type'] = 'llm') AS ok_llm,
        sumIf(ifNull(Cost, 0), StatusCode != 2 AND SpanAttributes['langwatch.span.type'] = 'llm')
          AS ok_llm_cost
      FROM spans
      WHERE (spans.TenantId, spans.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( StartTime >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND StartTime < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
      GROUP BY TraceId, SpanName, is_tool
    )
    GROUP BY TraceId
  ) AS s ON s.TraceId = t.TraceId)

    e.EvaluatorName AS evaluator,
    count() AS reviewed,
    avg(e.Passed = toUInt8(a.up)) AS agreement,

    c.StatusCode = 2 AS failed,
    c.StatusCode = 2 AND p.StatusCode != 2 AS recovered
  FROM spans AS c
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT TraceId, SpanId, StatusCode
    FROM spans
    WHERE (spans.TenantId, spans.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( StartTime >= subtractDays({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, 1) AND StartTime < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
  ) AS p ON p.TraceId = c.TraceId AND p.SpanId = c.ParentSpanId
  WHERE (c.TenantId, c.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( c.StartTime >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND c.StartTime < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
    AND c.ParentSpanId IS NOT NULL
    AND c.SpanAttributes['langwatch.span.type'] = 'tool')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.SpanName AS step, r.StatusCode = 2 AS failed, false AS recovered
  FROM spans AS r
  LEFT ANTI JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT TraceId, ParentSpanId
    FROM spans
    WHERE (spans.TenantId, spans.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( StartTime >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND StartTime < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
      AND ParentSpanId IS NOT NULL)
  ) AS k ON k.TraceId = r.TraceId AND k.ParentSpanId = r.SpanId
  WHERE (r.TenantId, r.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( r.StartTime >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND r.StartTime < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
    AND r.ParentSpanId IS NULL
    AND r.SpanAttributes['langwatch.span.type'] = 'tool')
)
GROUP BY step
ORDER BY failures - recovered DESC, failures DESC, calls DESC
LIMIT 50

label: noise/sources
sql:
SELECT source, uniqExact(TraceId) AS traces, sum(cost) AS cost
FROM (
  SELECT s.TraceId AS TraceId, s.cost AS cost,
    multiIf(has(['playground', 'evaluation', 'simulation'], t.origin), t.origin,
      has(['test', 'testing', 'staging', 'stage', 'dev', 'development', 'qa', 'sandbox', 'local'], s.environment), s.environment,
      has(['test', 'testing', 'staging', 'stage', 'dev', 'development', 'qa', 'sandbox', 'local'], t.environment), t.environment,
      arrayFirst((label) -> has(['test', 'testing', 'staging', 'stage', 'dev', 'development', 'qa', 'sandbox', 'local'], label), t.labels)) AS source
  FROM (
    SELECT TraceId, Attributes['langwatch.origin'] AS origin,
      lower(coalesce(nullIf(Attributes['metadata.environment'], ''),
        nullIf(Attributes['metadata.env'], ''), '')) AS environment,
      arrayMap((label) -> lower(label),
        JSONExtract(Attributes['langwatch.labels'], 'Array(String)')) AS labels
    FROM traces
    WHERE (traces.TenantId, traces.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
  ) AS t
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT TraceId, sum(Cost) AS cost,
      lower(any(coalesce(nullIf(ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment'], ''),
        nullIf(ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'], '')))) AS environment
    FROM spans
    WHERE (spans.TenantId, spans.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( StartTime >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND StartTime < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
    GROUP BY TraceId
  ) AS s ON s.TraceId = t.TraceId
)
GROUP BY source
ORDER BY traces DESC
LIMIT 20

label: cost-accuracy/trend
sql:
SELECT addSeconds(toStartOfInterval(subtractSeconds(OccurredAt, 345600), INTERVAL {dashboard_context_granularity_seconds:UInt32} SECOND), 345600) AS bucket,
  uniqExactIf(TraceId, notEmpty(Models)) AS with_model,
  uniqExactIf(TraceId, UnpricedSpanCount > 0) AS unpriced
FROM trace_metrics
WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket

label: cost-accuracy/models
sql:
SELECT model, uniqExact(TraceId) AS traces
FROM trace_metrics
ARRAY JOIN UnpricedModels AS model
WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
GROUP BY model
ORDER BY traces DESC
LIMIT 5
